description: Spectral flatness of white noise under magnitude and power weights.
name: 54-noise-flatness

recipe.band: bins from 100 Hz to 10 kHz inclusive
recipe.flatness: geometric over arithmetic mean of the weights, magnitude |X| or power |X|^2; mean over frames
recipe.scale: magnitude divided by the window sum, then floored at 1e-5
recipe.signal: gaussian(seed + m, 4096) for frame m, windowed by a periodic Hann
